propositions: disposition-closed children (duplicate, not_a_bug, escalated) with live replacement links are exempted from verification at close but still withheld from parent certification because child_closure_findings demands a completion-verifier attestation unconditionally

the close path and certification path apply contradictory rules: close grants dispositions an exemption and mints no attestation; certification requires an attestation on every closed child, creating an uncertifiable state with no honest remedy

a disposition close with a live replacement link should mint a completion-verifier attestation reading DISPOSITION plus replacement id, not PASS, so the manifest records the exemption truthfully and certification can resolve through the replacement
force-close must remain unsigned even when applied to a linked duplicate, to prevent it from becoming a bypass of verification

the docstring of _completion_precheck was not updated when the disposition branch was added, leaving callers and readers with an incorrect contract and enabling the false inference that unsigned implies forced or off
